intro: Queen Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn was the beloved wife of King Varian Wrynn and the mother of young King Anduin. Her tragic death during the Stonemasons' riot shattered the royal household and triggered the exile of the craftsmen who would become the Defias Brotherhood.

p: Born to the minor House of Ellerian, which held modest holdings in Westfall, Tiffin's betrothal to Prince Varian Wrynn was arranged at birth to secure her family a seat in Stormwind's House of Nobles. Though the two initially chafed at the arrangement, their bond grew deep and enduring. Tiffin's calm demeanor grounded Varian's temper, and her kindness made her widely cherished by commoners and nobility alike.

When tensions over payment for Stormwind's reconstruction boiled over into civil strife, Queen Tiffin stood as one of the few prominent voices urging the House of Nobles to pay the Stonemasons' Guild in full. While trying to appease the furious laborers during a riot in the streets, she was struck and killed by a thrown rock. Her sudden death plunged King Varian into profound grief and hardened his wrath against the rioters, driving Edwin VanCleef and the stonemasons into exile across Westfall.
